user.title: What do you want to hold?
user.description:
Hold keeps occupancy On for a user-set time after motion stops. Lights won't switch off while you're still there.

You can add a door latch on the next screen.

menu_option_descriptions.sensor_hold: Hold a single motion or occupancy sensor.
menu_option_descriptions.area_hold: Combine every motion and occupancy sensor in an area.

sensor_hold.title: Hold one sensor
sensor_hold.description: Occupancy stays on for the hold time after this sensor last detects motion.

data_description.name: Optional. Leave blank to name it after the sensor or area, e.g. Ensuite Hold, or Ensuite Latch with a door latch.
data_description.hold_time: How long occupancy stays on after motion, in seconds.
data_description.hold_mode: IKEA VALLHORN style counts from the last motion. For presence sensors that stay on, count from when motion clears.
data_description.source_entity: Only motion and occupancy sensors are listed. For a door latch, the fastest-clearing one works best, e.g. an IKEA VALLHORN's Motion rather than its Occupancy.
data_description.attach_to_sensor: Optional. Puts this hold's entities on the motion sensor's own device instead of creating a new one.
data_description.add_latch: Optional. Keeps the room occupied while you're inside with the door shut, even if you sit still. Set up on the next screen.

area_hold.title: Hold a whole room
area_hold.description: Every motion and occupancy sensor in the area feeds one hold. Sensors added to the area later are picked up automatically.

data_description.name: Optional. Leave blank to name it after the sensor or area, e.g. Ensuite Hold, or Ensuite Latch with a door latch.
data_description.hold_time: How long occupancy stays on after motion, in seconds.
data_description.hold_mode: IKEA VALLHORN style counts from the last motion. For presence sensors that stay on, count from when motion clears.
data_description.add_latch: Optional. Keeps the room occupied while you're inside with the door shut, even if you sit still. Set up on the next screen.
data_description.area: Sensors assigned to this area, directly or through their device, are included.

latch.title: Door latch
latch.description: Once the doors are in the latch position and the latch is triggered, the room stays occupied until a door moves.

data_description.door_entities: Pick one or more. With several, the room counts as closed only when all are closed, and open when any is open.
data_description.latch_when: Most rooms latch while the doors are closed.
data_description.latch_trigger: New motion is the safest: leaving and shutting the door behind you won't latch an empty room.
data_description.max_latch: Releases a stuck latch, e.g. if the door opening was missed. In seconds; 0 turns it off.

area_exclude.title: Sensors to leave out
area_exclude.description: Found {count} sensors in {area}. Pick any that shouldn't count, such as your own template sensors or camera detections you don't want. Leave it empty to use them all.

data_description.exclude_entities: Only sensors found in this area are listed.

error.door_is_source: The motion sensor can't also be a door sensor.
error.no_doors: Pick at least one door sensor.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hold & Latch is already set up. Use Add hold on its integration page to add another.

options.closed: While the doors are closed: stays occupied until a door opens (ensuite, toilet, study)
options.open: While any door is open: stays occupied until they're all closed (garage, shed; or if your sensor reports the opposite way round)

options.new_motion: New motion after the doors move into position (recommended)
options.motion_present: Any motion, including motion still showing when the doors move (can latch an empty room if you leave quickly)
options.door_only: The doors alone, no motion needed (e.g. a garage door left open)
